prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a bustling farm scene during the autumn harvest. On the far left, a farmer in a blue flannel shirt stands beside a large red tractor. The farmer holds a golden sheaf of wheat in one hand while pointing toward the center with the other. Next to the tractor sits a brown dog with floppy ears, looking up at the farmer expectantly. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow sunhat kneels on the dry earth, carefully placing ripe pumpkins into a wooden crate. Beside her, a small child in orange overalls watches intently, holding a single green apple. A black crow perches on the edge of the crate, observing the woman’s actions. Behind them, a tall scarecrow wearing a striped shirt stands rigidly among the stalks, its button eyes staring forward. To the right of the scarecrow, a white goat with curved horns grazes peacefully on leftover stubble. Further right, an elderly man in a grey vest leans against a rustic fence post, wiping sweat from his brow with a handkerchief. Next to him, a young girl in a pink dress sits on a hay bale, braiding her hair. A tabby cat rests on the hay bale next to the girl, sleeping soundly. In the background, a barn with faded red paint anchors the composition. A ladder leans against the side of the barn, leading up to the loft. A rooster with bright plumage stands near the barn door, crowing loudly. A basket of apples sits on the ground near the rooster, overflowing with fruit. There is no sky visible in the frame, focusing entirely on the earthly activities. There is no water source such as a pond or river present in the scene. The color palette remains warm and earthy, emphasizing the season's bounty through simple shapes and bold outlines without shading or gradients.
